In the Tibetan language: The Summary of the Empowerment. Homage to the glorious Vajrasattva. Zla-ba bzang-po <note>original: "Zla-ba bzang-po", meaning "Excellent Moon"</note> requested: O Teacher, the seven types of empowerment and the three types of that...

<summary>This page introduces the text "The Summary of the Empowerment" with an invocation to Vajrasattva and the beginning of a request by Zla-ba bzang-po regarding the seven and three types of empowerment.</summary>
<keywords>Empowerment, Vajrasattva, Zla-ba bzang-po, Initiation, Tantra</keywords>
